Property Overview

Executive-Style Value-Add in Anderson

A well-maintained 1960s two-story residence with mostly original finishes and a straightforward, cosmetic-driven renovation scope — an attractive off-market investment property for buyers targeting rental property investments and BRRRR opportunities in the Anderson / Indianapolis metro.

Solid Bones, Cosmetic Upside

1722 Corlett Way is a 2,758 sqft, four bedroom, 2.5 bath residence built in 1967, currently occupied. The structure presents as solid throughout, with nearly all identified improvements being cosmetic rather than structural in nature. Mechanical systems — including an efficient hydronic boiler, updated electrical panel, and replacement vinyl windows — appear serviceable, positioning this as a practical value-add opportunity for an investor comfortable with interior updating. The property also includes an attached 2-car garage and a detached storage shed. All observations are based on the photos and documentation provided; buyer to verify all information independently.
